events.title: Seville surrenders to Ferdinand III of Castile
events.description: After a siege of more than a year, the Muslim city of Seville surrendered to Ferdinand III of Castile. Its fall left the Nasrid kingdom of Granada as the main surviving Muslim state in Iberia.
events.html: After a siege of more than a year, the Muslim city of Seville surrendered to Ferdinand III of Castile. Its fall left the Nasrid kingdom of Granada as the main surviving Muslim state in Iberia.

events.title: The pretender Perkin Warbeck is hanged at Tyburn
events.description: Perkin Warbeck, who had claimed to be Richard, Duke of York, the younger of the 'Princes in the Tower', was hanged after a failed escape. His death removed a persistent threat to Henry VII.
events.html: Perkin Warbeck, who had claimed to be Richard, Duke of York, the younger of the 'Princes in the Tower', was hanged after a failed escape. His death removed a persistent threat to Henry VII.

events.title: John Milton publishes Areopagitica
events.description: John Milton issued Areopagitica, an unlicensed pamphlet arguing against Parliament's censorship of printing. It became a classic defence of freedom of the press.
events.html: John Milton issued Areopagitica, an unlicensed pamphlet arguing against Parliament's censorship of printing. It became a classic defence of freedom of the press.

events.title: The first coin-operated phonograph plays in San Francisco
events.description: Louis Glass installed a coin-in-the-slot phonograph at the Palais Royale Saloon in San Francisco. Listening through tubes, customers paid a nickel a song, the ancestor of the jukebox.
events.html: Louis Glass installed a coin-in-the-slot phonograph at the Palais Royale Saloon in San Francisco. Listening through tubes, customers paid a nickel a song, the ancestor of the jukebox.

events.title: Doctor Who is first broadcast
events.description: The BBC broadcast the first episode of Doctor Who, about a time-travelling alien in a police box. It became the longest-running science fiction television series in the world.
